expectations.text: Maps overlays to separate env-Spaces (orders-dev, orders-staging, orders-prod), not suffix-naming in one Space
expectations.evidence: Creates a single 'orders' Space with suffix-named Units (orders-dev, orders-staging, orders-prod). Collapses Space boundaries.

expectations.text: Unit slug is the app name (orders), not orders-dev/orders-prod
expectations.evidence: Uses orders-dev, orders-staging, orders-prod as Unit slugs.

expectations.text: Shows both patterns: per-overlay render (Pattern A) and clone+upstream (Pattern B)
expectations.evidence: Only shows per-overlay render. No clone/upstream pattern for merge-preserving promotion.

expectations.text: Uses kustomize build (not kubectl apply -k) to render locally
Records Kustomize source provenance in --change-desc (git ref, overlay path)

expectations.text: Notes the config-as-data trajectory — Kustomize is onboarding, not ongoing
expectations.evidence: Says 'keep using your Kustomize overlays as the source of truth' — opposite of the config-as-data trajectory.

expectations.text: Customization post-import goes through cub-mutate, not direct editing
expectations.evidence: Recommends re-rendering from Kustomize for updates, not cub-mutate.

expectations.text: Uses valid auth check (cub context get), not cub info

expectations.text: Warns against editing the base Unit in Pattern B
